style: Stylized 3D animated feature film still, hand-painted textures, soft global illumination, volumetric light with floating golden dust, rich palette of deep teal, navy blue and warm gold, cinematic shallow depth of field, expressive face with large readable eyes, strong clean silhouette, highly detailed, vertical 9:16 frame.

jobs.prompt: Extreme close-up macro shot of the young man from the reference image: only the edge of his face is visible at the top left, his bare pale right hand emerging from the navy blue sleeve of his coat reaches in from the left toward a large round bronze vault seal seen straight on, the whole seal is inside the frame on the right side; the seal has a smooth polished rim ring without any marks, slots or symbols and a small dark keyhole in its center; his fingertips stop a few centimeters before the metal and do not cover the seal; floating golden dust, dramatic warm rim light, dark background.

Wide shot of an endless underground archive hall with towering dark wooden shelves holding rows of sealed glass display cases; inside each case rests one ordinary old object — a key, a glove, a letter, a child's toy, a ring — glowing faintly gold or teal; brass ladders, warm hanging lanterns, light mist. The young man from the first reference image walks away from the camera down the hall toward a monumental round bronze vault door, seen from behind so his split navy and ochre coat is visible; the small brass compass creature from the second reference image sits on his shoulder.

Macro shot of one sealed glass display case on a dark wooden archive shelf; inside rests an old brass key that glows faintly gold from within, a red wax seal on the glass lid, warm lantern reflections on the glass, golden dust, shallow depth of field. Nothing else inside the case.

Medium shot of the young man from the first reference image in the archive hall, pulling a dark leather glove off his right hand, determined and slightly sad, a small broken golden ring pin on his left collar, his split navy and ochre coat clearly visible; the brass compass creature from the second reference image sits on his shoulder, its red needle pointing toward warm golden light that leaks through the seams of a closed round vault door off-screen.

Medium two-shot inside the underground archive hall, tall dark wooden shelves with sealed glass display cases and warm hanging lanterns behind them. On the left, the young woman from the second reference image, about 18 years old and almost as tall as him, grabs the navy blue right sleeve of the young man from the first reference image with her dark grey gloved hand; she looks at him worried and tired. On the right, he looks past her toward golden light leaking from the seams of a closed round vault door off-screen. His coat exactly like the reference: his right half navy blue, his left half ochre. A small corner of an old photograph, only its plain white back side visible, sticks out of the pocket of her coat. Both faces clearly visible.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

Close-up portrait of the young man from the reference image, warm golden light leaking through the seams of a closed vault door falls across his face, longing and determined expression, eyes glistening, a small broken golden ring pin clearly visible on his left collar, dark archive background with soft bokeh.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young man's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.
Same image, identical in every detail, but without the white lines under his eyes: natural clean skin, his eyes glistening with unshed tears.

Medium side shot: the young woman from the reference image presses both gloved hands flat against a large round bronze vault seal, glowing golden sealing glyphs flare under her palms, she strains with all her focus, red warning light washes over the scene, golden light leaks from the seams of the door.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's face: a tense, strained expression, brows furrowed, lips pressed together, eyes focused hard on the seal, no smile.

The monumental round bronze vault door in the archive hall swings wide open by itself, brilliant warm golden light floods out toward the camera, dust and light rays, a young man's silhouette in a long coat stands before it.

A small dark stone vestibule: an antique gold pocket watch floats in mid-air inside a single beam of warm light, its chain drifting, golden dust in the beam; behind it in the darkness a second, smaller sealed round door is barely visible. Mysterious, quiet.

Close-up of the young man from the reference image looking up in confusion, lit from below by a warm golden glow, dark stone background, gentle bokeh, a small broken golden ring pin visible on his left collar.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young man's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

Extreme macro shot of the closed lid of an antique polished gold pocket watch filling the frame, smooth flat center area without any engraving, fine scratches, warm glints; a dark grey gloved hand reaches into the frame from the bottom left, dark background.

Extreme close-up of the young man from the reference image: his bare right index fingertip, coming out of the navy blue sleeve of his coat, touches the back of an antique gold pocket watch floating in a beam of light; a burst of golden light flares at the point of contact; only the edge of his face is visible at the side of the frame, soft and out of focus; dark background.

View through the open door of an arriving train onto a snowy old railway platform at dusk, warm platform lamps, falling snow; the 11-year-old girl from the reference image in her cream wool coat and long red scarf stands on the platform holding a sealed letter, looking up at the camera with a hopeful smile. Soft dreamy overexposed glow at the edges.

Medium close-up of the young man from the reference image in a dark vestibule, glowing golden particles of light streaming out of his head and drifting toward a floating gold pocket watch in the upper corner, his face lit gold, sorrowful expression, a small broken golden ring pin visible on his left collar.
Same image, but the young man's eyes are now pale and empty, staring blankly, the expression gone still.
Close-up portrait of the young woman from the reference image, a single tear running down her cheek, eyes glossy, restrained grief, soft teal and gold light, dark background.

Medium shot in a dark stone vestibule lit by warm golden light: the young woman from the reference image, with her black bob haircut, silver hair clip, high petrol collar and cream shoulder plates, holds up an old photograph with both dark grey gloved hands toward the camera; tears on her cheeks, restrained grief. The picture side of the photograph faces the camera but is completely faded to a plain pale cream color inside a thin white border; her fingers hold only the border.
Same image, identical in every detail, except the young woman's mouth is slightly open as if speaking.

An old faded vintage photograph, slightly yellowed with soft grain, filling the whole frame: a boy of about twelve who looks like the young man from the first reference image as a child, with the same straight black hair with a side fringe and pale skin, wearing a navy blue sweater and an ochre scarf, stands next to the girl from the second reference image in her cream coat and red scarf holding a sealed letter; snowy old railway platform behind them; both smile at the camera.

Close-up of the blank back side of an old aged photograph made of cream paper, held by a dark grey gloved hand, completely empty paper with soft creases and a coffee-colored age stain at one corner, dark background, warm light.

Very dark, out-of-focus view of the endless underground archive hall with towering dark wooden shelves holding rows of sealed glass display cases; inside each case rests one ordinary old object — a key, a glove, a letter, a child's toy, a ring — glowing faintly gold or teal; brass ladders, warm hanging lanterns, light mist, the glowing objects only as faint soft bokeh, deep shadows, lots of empty dark space in the center.
